sources: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries — Kenya, Corporate Other taxes (last reviewed 17 July 2026): IDF 2.5% of customs value; RDL 2% of customs value; VAT 16% standard, 8% on fuel.
EAC Common External Tariff 2022 — four bands 0%, 10%, 25%, 35%.
assumptions: Duty is charged on the CIF value; excise, where it applies, on CIF plus duty.

VAT is charged on CIF + duty + excise + IDF + RDL. This composition is a modelling choice, is configurable per quote, and must be confirmed against a live KRA assessment before any figure is issued to a client.
